title: Cover note for kernel reviewers (GKH, Linus, kernel.org)
description: Mark 2026-10-23: one short document for Greg Kroah-Hartman, Linus Torvalds and the kernel.org admins (Konstantin Ryabitsev) to red-pen before any guide. Larry mode, kernel register (terse, no marketing): what git-vouch replaces (gpg binary + pgpkeys.git), what it is (SSH signing via ssh-keygen -Y and git, a signer registry kept in a git repo, small single-purpose tools), the threat model (what attacks it stops, what it does not), what it deliberately does not do (no new crypto, no network trust roots, no OpenPGP, no forge refs, no central service; the TRQP bridge is optional), the flag-day plan and late cutoff in five lines, and what kernel.org would operate. Every claim cites DESIGN.md. Under 2 pages. File: docs/for-kernel-reviewers.md (name may change), linked first from README.
acceptance_criteria: Exists, <2 pages, every claim cites a DESIGN.md section, independent reviewer finds no AI tells per ~/TASKS/styleguide-scrub-ai.md and no claim the code does not back.
